invariants.rationale: The method is expected to return a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata reflecting the result of the clustering operation.
The clustering operation requires a non-null instant time to identify the clustering commit.
A successful write operation should yield a non-null list of WriteStatus objects.
The list of WriteStatuses can be empty or have non-negative size, but should never be negative.
The context parameter is required for execution and should not be null when exiting the method.
